purpose: Exhaustive direct-author audit for Gemini/Antigravity posts in #titan-kaggriculture. This supplements the original 21-entry manifest-era ledger with four genuinely omitted pre-manifest propositions while mapping every one of the 44 direct-author messages to a canonical proposition, refinement, rollup, or coordination-only disposition. It is part of the same convergence package and must be folded into GEMINI-ANTIGRAVITY.json when the master registry is next rewritten; it is not an independent policy authority.

scan.audit_note: Coordination, acknowledgements, ownership handoffs and path questions are still represented in message_map so the completeness claim cannot silently skip them. Repeated mechanics map to the existing proposition instead of minting duplicate V4 families.

historical_entries.literal_claim: After fail-closing analyzer OverflowError/ValueError, clip a hostile or buggy massive finite evaluated margin to [-65000, 65000] so it cannot dominate seat/index means.
historical_entries.best_form: Keep strict finite-number validation, redundant-outcome consistency, and overflow-safe derived subtraction, but reject a guessed universal +/-65000 clip because legitimate current-engine margins can exceed it. If an ingestion boundary has an authenticated magnitude contract, reject out-of-range records rather than clipping them; otherwise keep finite inputs unbounded and prefer structured rewards or score+opponent_score over unauthenticated margin-only records.
historical_entries.next_gate: Any default magnitude bound must come from the authenticated producer contract and prove it preserves legitimate current-engine outcomes; use reject-only semantics, never value clipping.

historical_entries.literal_claim: Sell surplus FERTILIZER as pure revenue when the quote is above a fixed threshold; after the false $1 warehouse branch was stopped, use THRESHOLD=25 with RESERVE=2 and compose it as a profitable leader-derived liquidation rule.
historical_entries.best_form: Preserve the real high-quote shed-FERT sale seam, but do not promote the historical static THRESHOLD=25/RESERVE=2 rule from incomplete leader-pin claims. FERT has no passive town demand, SELL consumes shed custody, and floor disposal is a distinct capacity trade. A current descendant must value each proposed sale against observed quote, future fertilize obligations, shed-capacity pressure, replacement opportunity, executable market-prefix capacity and downstream funding rather than a magic threshold/reserve pair.
historical_entries.next_gate: Reopen only through the incumbent seller/stockkeeping authority with current-native natural FERT-sale exposures, exact executable returned-action receipts, preserved fertilize reserve/value, and paired both-seat terminal economics. Do not revive the old threshold-25 constant as proof.

historical_entries.literal_claim: Exploit the daily Fibonacci HIRE reset on the terminal day by mass-hiring up to 16 extra hands, then use the final 24 turns to strip-mine the board without long-term wage cost.
historical_entries.best_form: Keep the daily reset and terminal-labor timing seam, but reject blind worker-count maximization. Sixteen total same-day hires cost 2583, unit rows execute before market HIREs so a new hand first works next callback, the default executable market prefix is 10 rows, EOD clears hands, and terminal reward is farm money only. The canonical descendant admits only cash-funded marginal hires with an executable disjoint HARVEST -> shed -> DROP -> same-turn SELL realization whose conservative value clears the exact Fibonacci wage, plus the source-bound preterminal step-697 route frontier.
historical_entries.next_gate: Keep default-OFF until current-native paired both-seat official-engine execution proves positive terminal cash delta and receipts every added HIRE, HARVEST, DROP and SELL; never promote from worker count or unliquidated cargo.

historical_entries.literal_claim: Use unbounded intraday carrying plus repeated BUY_PRODUCT WHEAT to hoard market supply and starve the opponent's animals by making emergency feed unavailable or unaffordable.
historical_entries.best_form: Literal WHEAT stockout/starvation is false: the engine has no market-stock availability check and a self-created buy/sell squeeze is exactly reversible absent outside flow. The surviving adversarial mechanism is external-demand price pressure: buy before a rival's real net WHEAT demand, let that demand move the curve, then unwind afterward. Keep it as a gauntlet/stress hypothesis rather than canonical TITAN production policy.
historical_entries.next_gate: Measure both seats of current V4 against authenticated real external WHEAT demand and neutral controls; do not revive literal unavailability/starvation or infer profit from a self-only round trip.
